GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER

TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Marketing.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Marketing.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Marketing.

4. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen
